annual_land_cover.name: Esri / Impact Observatory / Microsoft Sentinel-2 10 m Annual Land Cover
annual_land_cover.role: Primary annual land-cover classification used to derive candidate and strict permanent vegetation-to-Built/Bare transitions.

processing_boundary.name: FAO GAUL 2015 level1
processing_boundary.role: Kogi State processing extent used by the Colab raster workflow.
processing_boundary.transformation: Reprojected the original processing boundary; no simplification.

lga_overlay.source: Office for the Surveyor General of the Federation of Nigeria (OSGOF), Ehealth, United Nations Cartographic Section (UNCS)
lga_overlay.publisher: OCHA Nigeria / OCHA Field Information Services / HDX
lga_overlay.license: Creative Commons Attribution for Intergovernmental Organisations (CC BY-IGO)
lga_overlay.processing: Extracted 21 features and renamed attributes; geometries retained without simplification. Replaces the earlier third-party copy.
lga_overlay.role: Reference display and location identification; not a cadastral or lease boundary. State overlay and processing boundary are from different sources and may differ.

interpretation: Remote sensing establishes land-cover conversion within a polygon. It does not by itself establish causal attribution to a specific operator or activity.
